newsitem.title: USA: Iowa-S Minn feedlot cattle not well tested - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Iowa-S Minn feedlot cattle not well tested - USDA.

text.p: Steers and heifers were not well tested, compared with Tuesday's close, USDA said. Heifers: Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1150 lbs 1.5 ld 74.50.

Carcass basis steers and heifers not well tested with a higher undertone noted. Steers: Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1250 lbs few 119.00. Heifers: Select/mostly Choice 2-4 1075-1175 lbs 117.50-120.00 Reported sales for Wed: 700. Week to Date: 18,000
